consent.title: Before you start
consent.summary: Noor Quiz stores your name, language, timezone and your quiz activity so it can run quizzes and leaderboards for your community. Please read how we handle your data, then agree to continue.
consent.privacyLink: Read how we handle your data
consent.error.generic: We couldn't save your answer. Please try again.
consent.error.outdated: The terms were just updated. Please read them again and agree to continue.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.placeholder: This is a short summary while we prepare the full privacy policy. The final text will follow.
privacy.data.title: What we store
privacy.data.body: Your display name, language and timezone, the date you agreed to these terms, and your answers and scores in the communities you join.
privacy.use.title: How we use it
privacy.use.body: To run quizzes, show leaderboards and streaks in your communities, and send the reminders you ask for.
privacy.rights.title: Your choices
privacy.rights.body: You can see and change your profile at any time. You will be able to delete your account and its data from your profile.
privacy.contact.title: Questions
privacy.contact.body: If you have a question about your data, ask the organiser of your community. A direct contact address will be added with the final text.
